recordedAfter: #1657 Clerk/Expo mobile auth dependencies (@clerk/expo, expo-secure-store, expo-web-browser, expo-auth-session, expo-crypto)
note: SECOND recording, superseding the 2026-09-19 post-Wave-1 baseline. Re-recorded because #1657 added the Clerk/Expo auth dependencies, whose modules Metro bundles statically even though the Clerk `require` is runtime-gated behind `authAvailable` — so every platform export grew by roughly 25-31% gzip. This is the accepted cost of the auth dependencies, NOT a NativeWind regression: `nativewind` and `react-native-css` still resolve to the same exactly-pinned RC, `react-native-css` still resolves to a single copy, and `expo-doctor` plus all three exports still exit 0. The gate's percentage thresholds (webMaxDeltaPercent: 15, nativeMaxDeltaPercent: 20) are UNCHANGED; only the frozen reference bytes moved, so the delta items now measure changes AFTER the Clerk addition rather than the addition itself. The 2026-09-19 baseline was web gzip 347,166 B / iOS 1,774,298 B / Android 1,880,903 B; the new baseline is the local re-measurement below, which is a few dozen bytes above the CI gate-environment measurement (#1657 PR #1709: web 476,211 / iOS 2,582,381 / Android 2,691,853). Do not re-record to hide a regression; a reviewed commit is the only way this file changes.
